scenario: Connect a Gmail mailbox for metadata analysis
trigger: The user adds a Gmail account
library_capabilities: Gmail OAuth setup and Keychain token storage
expected_result: The account is securely configured and ready to sync

scenario: Connect a standards-based IMAP account
trigger: The user adds a non-Gmail provider
input: Host, port, transport security, username, credentials
library_capabilities: Generic IMAP configuration and secure credential storage
expected_result: The account is validated and ready to sync

scenario: Work with several independent mail accounts
trigger: The user switches or compares accounts
library_capabilities: Per-account configuration folders and isolated analytical stores
expected_result: Operations and queries remain scoped to the selected accounts

scenario: Run scheduled mailbox processing without an interactive session
trigger: launchd or SSH starts the CLI
input: Configured account and unlocked authorized Keychain
library_capabilities: Headless Keychain access and non-interactive CLI behavior
expected_result: The job authenticates without unexpected GUI prompts or fails clearly

scenario: Ingest one calendar month of mailbox metadata
trigger: A month is selected
library_capabilities: Period planning UID discovery metadata fetch transformation and export
expected_result: The month becomes queryable in DuckDB and later archived to Parquet

scenario: Backfill a historical date range
trigger: The user requests older mail
input: Account, mailboxes, UTC start and end
library_capabilities: Paged UID discovery and bounded per-email fan-out
expected_result: All matching metadata is processed without downloading bodies

scenario: Refresh recent metadata after new mail or flag changes
trigger: The app or scheduler starts an incremental refresh
library_capabilities: Incremental discovery reconciliation and idempotent upserts
expected_result: New changed moved and expunged messages are reflected locally

scenario: Continue work after force-quit crash or device restart
trigger: The library initializes with unfinished tasks
library_capabilities: Expired-lease recovery dependency scheduling and result reuse
expected_result: Processing resumes without repeating valid completed work

scenario: Observe a long-running sync and processing run
trigger: A period workflow is active
library_capabilities: Structured events counters stages warnings and failures
expected_result: The caller can display progress and diagnose blocked work

scenario: Recover from provider rate limiting or temporary network loss
trigger: IMAP returns a transient failure
library_capabilities: Persisted bounded backoff and retry scheduling
expected_result: The workflow pauses and resumes without losing its checkpoint

scenario: Correlate one Gmail message exposed through several labels
trigger: Gmail returns the same X-GM-MSGID with different UIDs
library_capabilities: Mailbox-location keys plus account-wide Gmail correlation
expected_result: Label copies can be joined without corrupting fetch identity

scenario: Add a domain-specific email transformation
trigger: The application initializes the library
library_capabilities: Typed transformer registration versioning retries and persisted output
expected_result: The transformer participates in durable per-email processing

scenario: Run independent extraction and classification steps concurrently
trigger: A fetched message has several ready transformations
input: Pipeline dependency graph and execution limits
library_capabilities: Bounded local CPU I/O and network parallelism
expected_result: Independent results complete faster while dependencies remain correct

scenario: Retry a transient transformer failure
trigger: A transformer returns retry or throws a classified transient error
library_capabilities: Bounded backoff with crash-safe replay
expected_result: The step eventually succeeds or reaches a stable failed state

scenario: Allow useful results when a nonessential transformer fails
trigger: An optional step exhausts retries
library_capabilities: Job completion with warnings and exportable failure metadata
expected_result: Required analytics remain available without hiding the optional failure

scenario: Reuse an expensive valid transformation in a later run
trigger: A matching message is processed again
input: Transformer name, version, input fingerprint, output schema
library_capabilities: Persisted result compatibility checks and reuse link
expected_result: The step is marked reused without repeating computation or network calls

scenario: List messages from a company during a date range
trigger: A user searches for correspondence
library_capabilities: Constrained email_metadata query with bound variables
expected_result: Titles, dates, domains, and mailboxes are returned

scenario: Count messages from one company per month
trigger: A user requests a yearly trend
library_capabilities: Virtual year and month dimensions with grouped count
expected_result: A chronological monthly count is returned

scenario: Compare sender-domain volumes by year
trigger: A user requests domain trends
library_capabilities: Grouped counts over logical live and archived data
expected_result: Each year and sender domain has a message count

scenario: Find the most frequent sender domains
trigger: A user requests a sender overview
library_capabilities: Grouped count ordered by generated count alias
expected_result: A ranked domain list is returned

scenario: Measure attachment prevalence and storage impact
trigger: A user requests attachment statistics
input: Optional domain mailbox or period filters
library_capabilities: Count average median and quantile over attachment count and size columns
expected_result: Attachment frequency and size distributions can be reported

scenario: Identify unusually large email sources
trigger: A user requests message-size statistics
library_capabilities: Bound parameterized quantile and grouped statistics
expected_result: Large-message patterns can be compared safely

scenario: Query recent and archived mail through one API
trigger: A query spans the current and earlier months
library_capabilities: Logical dataset merges DuckDB live Parquet archive and corrections
expected_result: The caller receives one current deduplicated result set

scenario: Temporarily inspect a complete email body
trigger: A user explicitly opens a message
library_capabilities: On-demand raw message fetch and temporary lease
expected_result: The body is available temporarily without entering the metadata archive

scenario: Download selected attachments only
trigger: A user selects one or more attachments
input: Message identity and MIME part identifiers
library_capabilities: Selective MIME fetch size limit progress and content lease
expected_result: Only requested attachments are atomically published for temporary use

scenario: Convert an HTML email into Markdown
trigger: A caller requests a Markdown representation
library_capabilities: On-demand HTML fetch extraction and Markdown conversion
expected_result: A temporary Markdown artifact is returned

scenario: Reclaim space used by downloaded bodies and attachments
trigger: A lease expires or cleanup is requested
library_capabilities: Explicit release expiry cleanup and abandoned-partial removal
expected_result: Disposable content is removed without affecting metadata

scenario: Export filtered metadata for spreadsheet analysis
trigger: A constrained query has been defined
library_capabilities: Safe analytical query and CSV serializer
expected_result: A deterministic CSV file is produced without downloading bodies

scenario: Export filtered metadata for another local tool
trigger: A constrained query has been defined
library_capabilities: Safe analytical query and JSON serializer
expected_result: A deterministic machine-readable JSON document is produced

scenario: Archive a closed month to Parquet
trigger: The UTC month closes or a historical range is frozen
input: Verified DuckDB period and schema versions
library_capabilities: Immutable staging write verification atomic publish and manifest commit
expected_result: Monthly email and processing datasets are durably archived

scenario: Resume a failed Parquet publication
trigger: A write verification or process interruption occurs
library_capabilities: DuckDB exporting snapshot retry and atomic publication
expected_result: The archive completes without losing or duplicating rows

scenario: Reflect a late flag label move or expunge in an old month
trigger: Incremental sync detects a change to archived metadata
input: Logical key source version and change or tombstone
library_capabilities: DuckDB correction overlay merged queries and later compaction
expected_result: Queries immediately show current state and Parquet is eventually corrected

scenario: Run the complete monthly workflow from scripts or launchd
trigger: A scheduled command starts after month close
library_capabilities: Non-interactive CLI deterministic output exit status and resumable workflow
expected_result: The month is synchronized processed projected verified and archived

scenario: Investigate why an email or period did not complete
trigger: A workflow is failed blocked or unexpectedly slow
input: Run, task, job, or message identity
library_capabilities: Queryable attempts state transitions errors timestamps and progress
expected_result: The responsible stage and actionable failure are visible
